mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workstudy_post (post_type, unit, unit_user_id, name, content, skill, headcount, hired_count, hourly_wage, hours_per_week, hours_per_month, academic_term, apply_deadline, interview_at, status, review_note, reviewer_id, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{postType}, #{unit}, #{unitUserId}, #{name}, #{content}, #{skill}, #{headcount}, #{hiredCount}, #{hourlyWage}, #{hoursPerWeek}, #{hoursPerMonth}, #{academicTerm}, #{applyDeadline}, #{interviewAt}, #{status}, #{reviewNote}, #{reviewerId}, #{reviewedAt}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update:
UPDATE workstudy_post
post_type = #{postType}, unit = #{unit}, unit_user_id = #{unitUserId}, name = #{name}, content = #{content}, skill = #{skill}, headcount = #{headcount}, hourly_wage = #{hourlyWage}, hours_per_week = #{hoursPerWeek}, hours_per_month = #{hoursPerMonth}, academic_term = #{academicTerm}, apply_deadline = #{applyDeadline}, interview_at = #{interviewAt}, status = #{status}, review_note = #{reviewNote}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, updated_at = NOW()
